_note: 2026-27 award year (July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027), from official federal/Florida pages read on 2026-11-07. Every entry has source_url; anything not from those pages has "estimate": true.

programs.name: Federal Pell Grant
programs.who: Undergraduates with financial need (FAFSA). Not eligible if Student Aid Index (SAI) is $14,790 or more in 2026-27.
programs.notes: Some students can receive up to 150% of their scheduled award (e.g. year-round enrollment). Grant — does not need to be repaid.

programs.name: Florida Bright Futures
programs.award: Florida Academic Scholars (FAS): 100% of tuition and applicable fees at a public institution. Florida Medallion Scholars (FMS): 75% of tuition and fees, but 100% when enrolled in an associate degree program at a Florida College System institution like MDC. Gold Seal (GSV/GSC): $48 per semester credit for A.S./CCC and B.S./B.A.S., $39 per credit for career certificates (PSAV).
programs.who: Florida high school graduates who meet GPA/test/service-hour requirements (FAS 3.50 weighted GPA, FMS 3.00).
programs.notes: Funds up to 100% of the program of study; Gold Seal up to 72 hours for A.S./CCC. Must be used within 5 years of high school graduation.

programs.name: Florida Student Assistance Grant (FSAG)
programs.award: Need-based; minimum $200 per year. Maximum is set by the Florida Legislature each year and MDC decides each student's amount.
programs.who: Florida residents, degree-seeking undergraduates with substantial financial need (FAFSA processed by MDC's deadline).
programs.notes: Career certificate students may qualify for FSAG-CE instead.

programs.name: Federal Work-Study
programs.award: Part-time job on or near campus; pay depends on the job and hours.

programs.name: MDC scholarships (MDC Foundation and others)
programs.who: MDC students; each scholarship has its own requirements.
